from gurobipy import *

def solve_problem():
    # Create a new model
    m = Model("Optimization_Problem")

    # 2. Variables
    vars = {}
    lin_expr = 0
    vars['Var_0'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=15.13, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_0')
    lin_expr += 8.44 * vars['Var_0']
    vars['Var_1'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=13.44, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_1')
    lin_expr += 5.38 * vars['Var_1']
    vars['Var_2'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=9.34, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_2')
    lin_expr += 3.75 * vars['Var_2']
    vars['Var_3'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=10.27, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_3')
    lin_expr += 2.06 * vars['Var_3']

    m.setObjective(lin_expr, GRB.MAXIMIZE)

    # 3. Constraints
    m.addConstr(9.05 * vars['Var_1'] <= 52.4, name='C0')
    m.addConstr(7.38 * vars['Var_1'] <= 42.07, name='C1')

    # 4. Optimize
    m.optimize()
    return m

Subject: Mix plan for Q1—maximize contribution within review bandwidth

Team,

As we finalize the Q1 operating plan, our goal is to maximize total gross contribution across a small set of revenue levers while staying inside two internal bottlenecks: Solutions Lab bandwidth and Security & Compliance review bandwidth. We can dial each lever anywhere from zero up to its market or contractual ceiling, subject to the notes below on whether we can make fractional or only whole-unit commitments.

Our levers
- Core Platform License Bundles (annual, thousand-seat lots)
  • Each additional bundle returns 8.44 in gross contribution.  
  • We may commit anywhere from 0 up to 15.13 bundles this quarter, and because bundles are contracted in lots, the count must be a whole number.  
  • This lever does not draw on Solutions Lab bandwidth or Security & Compliance review bandwidth.

- Bespoke Integration Projects
  • Each project-equivalent adds 5.38 in gross contribution.  
  • We may take on anywhere from 0 up to 13.44 project-equivalents, and partial engagements are acceptable (fractional scheduling is allowed).  
  • This is the only lever that consumes our two constrained bandwidths: each project-equivalent uses 9.05 units of Solutions Lab bandwidth and 7.38 units of Security & Compliance review bandwidth.

- Customer Enablement Bootcamps (cohorts)
  • Each cohort contributes 3.75 in gross contribution.  
  • We may schedule anywhere from 0 up to 9.34 cohorts, and these are planned in whole cohorts only.  
  • No Solutions Lab or Security & Compliance bandwidth is required for this lever.

- Premium Support SLAs (enterprise blocks)
  • Each block contributes 2.06 in gross contribution.  
  • We may commit anywhere from 0 up to 10.27 blocks, and commitments must be in whole blocks.  
  • This lever does not consume either constrained bandwidth.

Facility specs and market limits
- Solutions Lab bandwidth available for Q1: 52.4 units in total.  
- Security & Compliance review bandwidth available for Q1: 42.07 units in total.

Please use the above as the basis for the Q1 allocation. The intent is to push total contribution as high as possible while never exceeding 52.4 units of Solutions Lab bandwidth or 42.07 units of Security & Compliance review bandwidth, and while staying within the individual ceilings and whole-unit requirements noted for each lever.
